content: Open daily from 08:00 to 22:00, including weekends. The center is closed only on Lunar New Year's Eve.
content_zh: 每日 08:00–22:00 營業，週末照常開放；僅農曆除夕休館。
aliases: hours|business hours|open|close|營業時間|開門|關門

content: Staff are at the front desk from 09:00 to 20:00 daily. Self-service entry is available to confirmed pass holders outside staffed hours.
content_zh: 櫃檯每日 09:00–20:00 有專人服務；已確認方案的顧客可在其餘營業時段自助入場。
aliases: front desk|staff hours|service hours|櫃檯時間|服務時間

content: Beacon Study Hub is at 88 Mingguang Road, Sanmin District, Kaohsiung City. This is a fictional address created for this course project.
content_zh: 微光自習室位於高雄市三民區明光路 88 號；此地址為課程專案所虛構。

content: From the fictional Mingguang MRT Station Exit 2, walk east for about five minutes. Bus routes 18 and 88 stop at Mingguang Road Entrance.
content_zh: 從虛構的明光捷運站 2 號出口向東步行約 5 分鐘；18 路與 88 路公車可在明光路口站下車。

content: There are 12 bicycle spaces at the entrance. Cars and scooters may use the fictional Mingguang Public Parking Lot across the street; parking fees are not included in study plans.
content_zh: 入口設有 12 個自行車位；汽車與機車可停放於對街的虛構明光公有停車場，停車費不含在自習方案內。
aliases: car park|bike|scooter|停車|汽車|機車|自行車

content: The front desk accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard, JCB, EasyCard, iPASS, Apple Pay, and LINE Pay. Online reservations accept Visa, Mastercard, and JCB.
content_zh: 櫃檯接受現金、Visa、Mastercard、JCB、悠遊卡、一卡通、Apple Pay 與 LINE Pay；線上預約接受 Visa、Mastercard 與 JCB。
aliases: pay|cash|credit card|mobile payment|付款|現金|信用卡|行動支付

content: Quiet desks can be used without a reservation when seats remain. Window seats, focus booths, meeting rooms, and group rooms should be reserved at least one hour before arrival.
content_zh: 安靜座位若現場尚有空位即可直接使用；窗邊座位、專注艙、會議室與團體討論室建議至少於抵達前 1 小時預約。

content: A reservation can be changed or cancelled without charge up to two hours before its start time. Later cancellations and no-shows are not refundable.
content_zh: 預約開始前 2 小時可免費更改或取消；逾時取消或未到者恕不退款。
aliases: refund|change booking|cancel|no show|取消|改期|退款|未到

content: Please keep phones silent in quiet zones, take calls only in phone booths, and return shared equipment after use. Repeated disruption may be referred to staff.
content_zh: 安靜區請將手機調為靜音，通話僅限電話亭內，公用設備使用後請歸還；若持續影響他人，將轉由現場人員處理。
aliases: rules|noise|phone calls|quiet zone|規則|音量|講電話|安靜區

content: Covered drinks and light snacks are allowed at standard desks. Hot meals and strong-smelling food are allowed only in the lounge; food is not allowed in focus booths or meeting rooms.
content_zh: 一般座位可攜帶有蓋飲料與輕食；熱食及氣味較重的食物僅限休息區，專注艙與會議室內禁止飲食。

content: Free Wi-Fi and one power outlet per seat are included with every plan. The Wi-Fi network name and daily password are displayed at the front desk after check-in.
content_zh: 所有方案均含免費 Wi-Fi，且每席提供一個插座；完成報到後可在櫃檯查看當日網路名稱與密碼。

content: The entrance, main study floor, accessible restroom, and one meeting room are wheelchair accessible. Customers who need seating assistance may contact the front desk in advance.
content_zh: 入口、主要自習區、無障礙洗手間及一間會議室皆可供輪椅通行；如需座位協助，可事先聯絡櫃檯。

content: Customers aged 12 or older may use the center. Anyone under 15 must provide a guardian contact at check-in and may not remain after 20:00 without an accompanying adult.
content_zh: 年滿 12 歲即可使用自習室；未滿 15 歲者報到時須提供監護人聯絡方式，且若無成人陪同不得於 20:00 後停留。

content: For complaints, accessibility arrangements, lost property, payment disputes, or questions not covered by the database, ask the assistant to transfer you to a staff member. Fictional service phone: 07-555-0188; fictional email: hello@beacon-study.example.
content_zh: 如需申訴、無障礙安排、失物協尋、付款爭議，或資料庫沒有答案的問題，可請助理轉接真人。虛構客服電話：07-555-0188；虛構信箱：hello@beacon-study.example。
